title: Popcorn Machine Category, HSN and GST
intro: Seven live products in the KitchenaryKart Popcorn Machine category — four electric and three gas models, including a cart trolley and a battery-rotated table top — with the website category, HSN code and GST rate recorded against each SKU.

notes: GST: every SKU in this category is recorded at 18%.

HSN: every SKU in this category is recorded at 84198190 — machinery for the treatment of materials by a change of temperature. A popcorn machine heats its kettle, so the heading fits the electric and the gas models alike, and the category is internally consistent.
KKHE0235-GPMSSB is gas-heated but uses a 12 V battery to turn the pot. The battery drives rotation only, not heating, so it does not change the heading.

Five of the seven are currently out of stock on the website; only KKHE0230-EPMSWC and KKHE0236-GPMRB are sellable. Stock does not affect HSN or GST, noted only so the list is not mistaken for a live availability report.
